Mauritius- Pipeline Replacement Project
SBI has extended a Government of India backed INR based Line of Credit of Rs. 487.60 Crs to the Government of Mauritius for financing of water pipeline replacement project. The Line of Credit has been extended under the Indian Development and Economic Assistance Scheme (IDEAS) guidelines of Government of India. Government notification for the financing is provided
here
.
Broad Process that will be followed for implementation of the LoC is as under:
Presently the inputs/ documents required for launching the Expression of Interest (EOI) are being finalized and shortly Bank will call for EOI from Indian Contractors.
The EOI will also be published in National/ Economic Newspaper and the same EOI will also be hosted here.
Watch out this space for further developments.
